title: AITA for not offering to pay for the repair of my friend’s phone which I bumped out of her hand accidentally
question: AITA for not offering to pay for the repair of my friend’s phone which I bumped out of her hand accidentally
body:
My friend got a new phone recently. She and I were chatting on the way to the bus stop when we saw the bus coming and we started running because missing the bus could mean waiting another 30 mins... as I ran I bumped her accidentally and she dropped her phone. 

She kept saying ‘nice one’ to me angrily after that and told others that the scuff marks on her phone were because ‘(me) dropped it’. Which pissed me off and I said ‘I didn’t drop it, it was in your hands and you let go of it!’ 

A week later she tells me she has to send it off for repairs which is costing £100 and she said ‘it’s probably because you dropped it’. I told her again that I didn’t drop her damn phone as I wasn’t holding it. She didn’t ask me to pay for it. 

I feel maybe I’m responsible but I’m sick of her telling me that I dropped the phone- no I didn’t and if you were holding your phone tightly while we were running it wouldn’t have fallen out of your grip from a little bump from me. 

I don’t want to fall out over it but the way she is acting is making me think it’s not worth offering to pay for it.
